units.source_text: 岛村忽然想起了几年前自己到这个温泉浴场同驹子相会、在火车上山野的灯火映在叶子脸上时的情景，心房又扑扑地跳动起来。

en.t: Shimamura suddenly remembered how, several years earlier, he had come to this hot spring resort to meet Komako, and how the lights of the mountains and fields had been reflected on Yoko's face in the train; his heart began to pound again.

units.source_text: 仿佛在这一瞬间，火光也照亮了他同驹子共同度过的岁月。

en.t: It was as if, in that instant, the firelight had also illuminated the years he and Komako had spent together.

units.source_text: 这当中也充满一种说不出的苦痛和悲哀。

en.t: Those years, too, were filled with an indescribable pain and sorrow.
